pages.text: The Portable Grid is a handheld version of the Grid that allows you to access your storage network from anywhere. It requires a Network Card to function.
Features:$(li)Portable access to your storage network$(li)All features of a regular Grid$(li)Requires a Network Card$(li)Works within range of a Wireless Transmitter$(li)Can be used while moving

To use the Portable Grid:$(li)Insert a Network Card$(li)Use within range of a Wireless Transmitter$(li)Right-click to open the interface$(li)Use like a regular Grid$(li)Can be used while moving around
